# Third-party notices

<!-- Generated by crates/ticoraw-py/scripts/third_party_notices.sh from crates/ticoraw-py/about.hbs and packaging/about/about.toml. Do not edit by hand. -->

The `ticoraw` Python package is licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE-MIT` and
`LICENSE-APACHE`). Its compiled extension module contains the Rust crates listed below,
each under its own licence. Test, benchmark and build-time dependencies are not part of
the built software and are not listed. The numpy Python package, which is installed
alongside as a dependency, carries its own licence.

## Independent JPEG Group

This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.

The JPEG encoder used for DNG previews contains code derived from the Independent JPEG
Group's software; its licence text, with the copyright notices, is reproduced below.
